title: Performance of the biological nitrification-denitrification Linpor process (Freising, Germany)

cell_spans.description: Printed 'Design' spans the Influent and Effluent columns
Printed 'Operation' spans the Influent and Effluent columns

markdown:
|  | Design Influent | Design Effluent | Operation Influent | Operation Effluent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BOD (mg/l) | 222 | - | 106 | 3 |
| COD (mg/l) | 397 | - | 208 | - |
| TKN (mg/l) | 46.6 | - | 29 | <0.6 |
| NH₄⁻-N (mg/l) | 35.9 | <5 | 16 | <0.1 |
| NOₓ⁻-N (mg/l) | 2.6 | - | - | 9.9 |
| Total-N (mg/l) | 49.2 | <18 | 29 | 9.9 |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source:  Gilligan and Morper, 1999' (two spaces after the colon).

Printed as 'NH4--N' in this table: subscript 4 followed by a superscript minus. Table 5.53 on page 492 prints the same species as 'NH4+-N' with a plus. The printed minus is retained and not corrected.
Printed as 'NOx--N' with a subscript x and a superscript minus; written NOₓ⁻-N. Not corrected.
The printed top-left header cell is empty and the stub column carries no heading; kept as an empty header cell.
Printed 'Total-N' with a hyphen while neighbouring tables print 'T-N'; retained.
The caption title is printed on two centred lines and joined here with a space, as for Table 5.61.

Printed values are kept as printed without recomputation: the Design Influent total-N prints 49.2 while the Operation Influent total-N prints 29, and the three Effluent columns mix '-' and '<' values.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All six rows and four value columns read from a 420 dpi crop; the NH4 and NOx charge signs confirmed at 800 dpi against the plus sign in Table 5.53.
